facts.fact: The National Treasury's Estimates of National Expenditure 2024, tabled 21 February 2024, name R15 million for the automation of birth registration in 41 health facilities in 2024/25, within the Home Affairs vote's Transversal Information Technology Management subprogramme (R1,190.1 million appropriated, revised to R1,110.6 million on 30 October 2024).

The Estimates of National Expenditure 2024 place the automation of birth registration in 41 health facilities under Vote 5, Home Affairs, as a component of the department's own information technology subprogramme for 2024/25.
